verdict.rationale: Together AI supports LoRA and full fine-tuning on its platform and lets ml-engineers deploy their fine-tuned model (including LoRA adapters) to a dedicated endpoint via console, API, SDK, or CLI [together-ai-docs-11][together-ai-docs-17][together-ai-docs-18][together-ai-docs-32]. However, the evidence describes fine-tuning within Together's own pipeline (data upload → training → hosting) rather than explicit support for uploading externally pre-trained custom weights/adapters not produced via Together's fine-tuning job. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading externally-trained model weights/LoRA adapters (not generated through Together's own fine-tuning job) and independent confirmation this works in practice.
